source.title: International Assistance Programs section (Table-5 OVER-CAP sub-split, spans pages 19-20), unit 2 of 2: the department-level remainder + the grand roll-up to Total--International Assistance Programs. Holds Millennium Challenge Corporation, the Multilateral Assistance bureau (a single substantive line + Proprietary + its Total--), Peace Corps (+ its Proprietary), International Monetary Programs, the subtotal-less Military Sales Program lines (Foreign Military Sales Trust Fund, Other, Proprietary), the department-direct 'Other', and the TWO multi-line bureau Total-- rows (International Security Assistance, Agency for International Development) RE-ANCHORED from the sibling -international-assistance-bureaus. Overseas Private Investment Corporation is dropped entirely (all '(**)'/'......'). Re-anchor pattern: -receipts-si-remainder / -education-departmental.
source.period: May FY2026 (This Month = May 2026; Current FYTD = Oct 2025 - May 2026; Prior FYTD = Oct 2024 - May 2025)

unit_note: USD millions ('[$ millions]' per table header). Table 5 legend (p. 23): '......' = 'No Transactions' (omitted); '(**)' = 'Less than absolute value of $500,000' (omitted). Second of two units for the over-cap International Assistance Programs section (spans p19->20). The two multi-line bureau Total-- rows (International Security Assistance, Agency for International Development) are RE-ANCHORED as leaves -- re-read from the render, never copied. The Overseas Private Investment Corporation rows are dropped (every cell '(**)'/'......'). Military Sales Program prints no subtotal, so its three lines feed the department total directly. Multilateral Assistance has only one substantive line ('Other') plus Proprietary: its net columns (c3/c6) roll up (2 sources) and its gross totals (c1/c4) are covered by the total-row net identity, but its single-source gross/net cells -- the 'Other' line's c1/c4/c7/c9 and the two Proprietary applicable cells -- participate in no >=2-source relation and are 'standalone' with a why (Total--Multilateral Prior-FYTD is instead re-anchored into the department roll-up). At the department level every Applicable column has many sources and rolls up normally. Non-default tolerances quote the Table-5 rounding note (p. 23): 'Note: Details may not add to totals due to rounding.'
